pose: A massive, two-part vertical pillar. The top (thigh) and bottom (shin) bones are stacked straight to support weight.
visual_hook: The 'Pillar-leg.' The foot is wide and round like an elephant's. The shin area is shorter and thicker than the thigh.
material: Matte, light-grey tan bone. Stony and weathered.
inset_view: Top-right corner: Cross-section of the bone showing dense, solid rings like an ancient tree.
